about.label: About PBO Vidar
about.title: About PBO Vidar
body: PBO VIDAR is a Ukrainian maritime engineering company developing manned and unmanned maritime solutions for defence, security and critical infrastructure protection.
Our expertise combines practical boatbuilding experience, electric propulsion technologies and maritime system integration with a mission-driven approach to engineering and development.
